claim_text: Available NCCIH evidence summary does not establish CoQ10 as a general treatment for nonspecific low energy or anti-aging; evidence varies by specific clinical indication and is insufficient for a generic wellness recommendation.

population.health_status: General wellness claim; not a defined diagnosed condition.
population.other_context: Do not extrapolate condition-specific studies to general wellness.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Coenzyme Q10 dietary supplement; formulations may vary.
evidence_summary: NCCIH Coenzyme Q10 topic page reports that evidence differs across indications and is inconclusive or insufficient for several commonly promoted outcomes. The page was last updated January 2019, so currentness review is required.
limitations: Source page is dated 2019 and requires a current literature search.
This is not a conclusion about all CoQ10 indications.
No dose recommendation is supported by this claim.
